f.organization_id = #{organizationId} AND c.deleted_at IS NULL AND (f.owner_member_id = #{owner} OR f.owner_member_id IS NULL)

SELECT count(*) FROM organization_member m JOIN app_user u ON u.id = m.user_id WHERE m.organization_id = #{organizationId} AND m.id = #{id} AND m.status = 'ACTIVE' AND m.role <> 'VIEWER' AND u.status = 'ACTIVE'

SELECT id, name FROM customer WHERE organization_id = #{organizationId} AND deleted_at IS NULL AND status = 'ACTIVE' AND name ILIKE '%' || #{query} || '%' AND (owner_member_id = #{owner} OR owner_member_id IS NULL) ORDER BY name, id LIMIT 50

SELECT m.id, u.display_name AS name FROM organization_member m JOIN app_user u ON u.id = m.user_id WHERE m.organization_id = #{organizationId} AND m.status = 'ACTIVE' AND u.status = 'ACTIVE' AND m.role <> 'VIEWER' AND m.id = #{owner} ORDER BY u.display_name, m.id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO follow_up (id, organization_id, customer_id, owner_member_id, origin, status, due_at, priority, score_version, reason, recommended_action_type, recommended_action, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{organizationId}, #{input.customerId}, #{input.ownerMemberId}, 'MANUAL', 'OPEN', #{input.dueAt}, #{input.priority}, 'manual-v1', COALESCE(#{input.reason}, ''), #{input.actionType}, jsonb_build_object('title', CAST(#{input.title} AS text), 'source', 'MANUAL'), #{now}, #{now})
mapper.update: UPDATE follow_up SET owner_member_id = #{input.ownerMemberId}, due_at = #{input.dueAt}, priority = #{input.priority}, reason = COALESCE(#{input.reason}, ''), recommended_action_type = #{input.actionType}, recommended_action = recommended_action || jsonb_build_object('title', CAST(#{input.title} AS text)), status = 'OPEN', snoozed_until = NULL, updated_at = #{now}, version = version + 1 WHERE organization_id = #{organizationId} AND id = #{id} AND version = #{input.version} AND status IN ('OPEN', 'IN_PROGRESS', 'SNOOZED')

UPDATE follow_up SET status = #{status}, completed_at = CASE WHEN #{status} = 'COMPLETED' THEN CAST(#{now} AS timestamptz) ELSE NULL END, updated_at = #{now}, version = version + 1 WHERE organization_id = #{organizationId} AND id = #{id} AND version = #{version} AND status IN ('OPEN', 'IN_PROGRESS', 'SNOOZED')

UPDATE follow_up SET status = 'SNOOZED', due_at = #{input.dueAt}, snoozed_until = #{input.dueAt}, reason = CASE WHEN COALESCE(#{input.reason}, '') = '' THEN reason ELSE #{input.reason} END, updated_at = #{now}, version = version + 1 WHERE organization_id = #{organizationId} AND id = #{id} AND version = #{input.version} AND status IN ('OPEN', 'IN_PROGRESS', 'SNOOZED')
